tasks.setup: deno run --allow-read --allow-run --allow-write src/bootstrap/config.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/gen-shape-docs.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-run --allow-write --allow-env scripts/gen-version.ts
tasks.compile: deno task setup && deno compile --include lang/grammar/rune.wasm --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run -o dist/rune src/bootstrap/mod.ts
tasks.build: deno task compile && deno task build:rust && mkdir -p dist && cp lang/target/release/rune-lsp lang/target/release/rune-syntax dist/
tasks.verify: deno task check:lockstep && deno task check:spec-refs && deno task check:agent-guardrail && deno run -A scripts/verify.ts

test:unit.description: parallel: deno test --parallel over the unit files scripts/lane.ts plans (REQ-278 lane; answers --plan)

test:int.description: parallel: deno test --parallel over the *.int.test.ts files scripts/lane.ts plans (REQ-278 lane; answers --plan)

tasks.test:e2e: deno test -A --parallel --unstable-raw-imports --config e2e/cake/deno.json e2e/cake/ && deno test -A --parallel --unstable-raw-imports --config e2e/checkout/deno.json e2e/checkout/

serve.description: REQ-278 — the cake app test:e2e drives, on PORT (the gate sets it)

tasks.cake: deno run -A npm:playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell && KEEP_BROWSER=1 KEEP_HEADED=1 deno test -A --unstable-raw-imports --config e2e/cake/deno.json e2e/cake/cake.e2e.test.ts
